blocks.html: Fields used to apply flexible filters on dates.

types.name: lt
types.description: The filtered date must be less than this value.

types.name: gt
types.description: The filtered date must be greater than this value.

types.name: gte
types.description: The filtered date must be greater than or equal to this value.

types.name: lte
types.description: The filtered date must be less than or equal to this value.
